name: Analytic Rendering of Curvilinear Volume Data
definition: A technique for rendering volume data from curvilinear grids by representing each curvilinear voxel as a cubic triparametric solid (Bezier solid) and rendering it directly into an accumulating image using a 3D forward difference operator, ensuring C1 continuity of shape and data across voxel boundaries.
summary: Analytic rendering of curvilinear volume data directly renders deformed grids using cubic Bezier solids, avoiding interpolation or triangular approximation while ensuring C1 continuity.
